item.title: Open Source Daily — Monday, October 26, 2026
item.description: PHP third RCE CVE-2026-115560 unpatched + PHP2Shell exploited from Oct 17; Brotli/Node2Shell reaches Go (vendor claim); Postiz CVE-2026-115933 (2.25.3); Nanbeige4.3-33B (Apache-2.0); systemd Rust + Linux 7.4 Binder/AI flood. Tool: MLX-Serve v26.10.3 stable. Quick: llama.cpp JSON depth limit; AV2/SVT-AV2; Linux 7.4 Apple M4 NVMe; Wild 0.11. Watch: PHP third-bug patch, Go Brotli advisories, Kimi K3.1 weights Nov 4.
